nevezz meg legalább egy ilyen részkérdést, még akkor is, ha a kezdeti
válasz már valószínűnek tűnik -- a részkérdés célja, hogy a lokális
gráfkeresés megerősítse vagy pontosítsa azt. Ne adj hozzá olyan tényt,
ami nincs a megadott riportrészletekben.

Csak az alábbi JSON-t add vissza, mást nem:
{"initial_answer": "<string>", "subquestions": ["<string>", "<string>"?]}

Kérdés: Fernando Alonso and Lewis Hamilton were teammates once. At which team and in which season, and what was the outcome of that season's championship?

Közösségi riportok:
[riport 60] The community primarily revolves around Fernando Alonso, a prominent Formula One driver known for his successful career with the Renault team, where he won two World Championships in 2005 and 2006. Alonso has also driven for Aston Martin since 2023 and has had notable teammates such as Esteban Ocon and Nelson Piquet Jr. The community highlights significant races, including the French Grand Prix, where Alonso achieved pole position in 2004, and the Belgian Grand Prix, where he recorded various results.
  - Fernando Alonso won the 2005 F1 World Championship while driving for Renault.
  - Alonso has driven for Aston Martin since 2023.
  - Alonso achieved pole position for the French Grand Prix in 2004.
  - Alonso recorded a result in the Belgian Grand Prix.
  - Alonso was teammates with Esteban Ocon at Alpine.
  - Alonso was teammates with Nelson Piquet Jr. at Renault.

[riport 33] The community primarily revolves around prominent Formula One drivers Lewis Hamilton, Nico Rosberg, and Valtteri Bottas, all of whom have driven for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. Hamilton and Rosberg were teammates from 2013 to 2016, during which Rosberg won the World Drivers' Championship in 2016. Bottas joined Mercedes in 2017 and remained until 2021, later returning as a reserve driver in 2024 and 2025. The community also highlights the competitive dynamics among these drivers, including their achievements and race results.
  - Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg were teammates at Mercedes from 2013 to 2016, during which Rosberg won the World Drivers' Championship in 2016.
  - Valtteri Bottas drove for Mercedes from 2017 to 2021 and later rejoined as a reserve driver in 2024 and 2025.

[riport 111] The 2020 Formula One season featured notable performances from drivers such as Charles Leclerc, who finished eighth in the standings and had a top-five finish at the Portuguese Grand Prix (N001, N004). Lewis Hamilton won the championship, securing his seventh title, while Max Verstappen and Valtteri Bottas also achieved significant results throughout the season (N106, E111). The season included various Grand Prix events, such as the Austrian Grand Prix, where Leclerc finished eighth and Hamilton claimed victory (N002, E001, E082).
  - Charles Leclerc finished eighth in the 2020 Formula One standings and had a top-five finish at the Portuguese Grand Prix.
  - Lewis Hamilton won the 2020 World Drivers' Championship, marking his seventh title.
  - The Austrian Grand Prix was a significant event in the 2020 season, with Hamilton winning and Leclerc finishing eighth.
